lines: There is room for another workshop along that ridge.
Give me a sound crew and a difficult job. I'll sleep well afterward.
I want to come back here in a hundred years and recognize something I built.
A good result deserves a celebration. A bad one deserves another drawing.

settler_0.reason: A fitted tool chest for the new quarters

lines: That joint will hold. I checked it before I admired it.
There is a place for every tool. I'll mark the places if that helps.
I put the date on my work. I expect to be answering for it a long time.
The machine has a rhythm when it is running properly. Listen for the missing beat.
